title: Penny API
description: Penny .NET API overview: health, traffic, errors, latency by route, logs and traces.

list.name: API starts
list.expr: max by (instance, service_version) (target_info{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}) unless max by (instance, service_version) (target_info{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"} offset 2m)

panels.title: Instances up
panels.description: API processes that exported telemetry in the last 5 minutes. Zero means the API is down or cannot reach Alloy.

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of requests answered with a 5xx status.

panels.title: Readiness failures
panels.description: Non-200 answers to /api/ready (the container health check) in the selected range.

panels.title: Sign-in failures
panels.description: Failed password, OIDC and registration attempts in the selected range.

panels.title: Job failures
panels.description: Background work that failed (and will be retried) in the selected range.

panels.title: Unhandled exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions that reached the ASP.NET Core exception handler in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(dotnet_process_cpu_time_seconds_total{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"}[5m])) / max by (instance) (dotnet_process_cpu_count{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment"})

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!~"api/(health|ready)"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (http_request_method, http_route, http_response_status_code) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!~"api/(health|ready)", http_response_status_code=~"[45].."}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: In flight and connections
panels.description: Queued connections above zero means Kestrel is not accepting connections fast enough.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!~"api/(health|ready)"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!~"api/(health|ready)"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, http_request_method, http_route) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="$service", instance=~"$instance", deployment_environment_name=~"$environment", http_route!~"api/(health|ready)"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Warnings and errors
panels.description: Expand a line and follow View trace to open the request in Tempo.

panels.title: Search logs
panels.description: Type in the Log search box at the top. Logs never contain user content, so search for ids, routes and messages.

panels.title: Failed requests and job passes
panels.description: Requests answered with a 5xx status and failed worker passes. Open a trace to see its SQL and outgoing calls.

panels.title: Trace by request id
panels.description: Paste the X-Request-Id a user reported (or the id from a 500 log line) into the Request id box at the top.
